$comment: PROPOSED format (SCH-001): not a frozen standard. It may change until stabilized by tests and an ADR. The Rust parser in crates/glint-schema is authoritative where this schema and the parser disagree; tests keep their field sets aligned. Unknown fields are rejected in every security-sensitive section; unknown keys inside author are ignored with warning GLINT_MANIFEST_WARN_UNKNOWN_FIELD (SCH-003, docs/architecture/manifest-compatibility.md). Breaking changes bump schemaVersion; packages are never migrated.
title: Glint theme manifest (glint.json) v1
description: Root manifest of a Glint theme package. All paths are relative to the package root and must stay inside it.

$schema.description: Editor hint only; Glint never dereferences it.

schemaVersion.description: Package format version, independent of the SDK and renderer entrypoint versions.

kind.description: Package kind. Only "theme" exists in v1.

id.description: Package identifier: two or more dot-separated lowercase segments, e.g. dev.example.midnight.

version.description: Semantic version (SemVer 2.0) of this package release.

author.description: Package author. Metadata only; never contacted by Glint. Unknown keys are not security-sensitive: they are ignored and reported as warnings.

license.description: License expression; an SPDX identifier such as MIT is expected.

compatibility.description: Supported Glint and SDK version ranges and operating systems.

renderer.description: Renderer contract for programmable surfaces. Required when any surface is declared.

requiredCapabilities.description: Capabilities the theme cannot run without.

optionalCapabilities.description: Capabilities used when available. Must not repeat a required capability (enforced by the parser).

assets.description: Named static assets, e.g. wallpaper and preview.

surfaces.description: Surfaces the theme provides, keyed by surface ID (e.g. panel, launcher, control-center or custom:<package-id>).

packagePath.description: Relative, /-separated path inside the package: no leading /, no empty, . or .. segments, no backslash or colon, no Windows-reserved characters or device names, no segment ending in . or space.

placement.description: Placement (kind, anchor, size, monitor); shape owned and validated by the surface engine (crates/glint-surfaces, SRF-001). See docs/architecture/surfaces.md.

behavior.description: Focus, dismissal, auto-hide and work-area behaviour; shape owned and validated by the surface engine (crates/glint-surfaces, SRF-001). See docs/architecture/surfaces.md.
